title: Chip banta kaise hai? Ret se supercomputer tak.
hooks: Tere phone ka dimag... ret se banta hai!
Ret se supercomputer? Haa, asli magic yahan hai.
Ek chip mein arab switches... kaise bane?
hook_why: Second-person, colloquial Hinglish, names the surprise (sand to supercomputer) in first 5 words. No greeting, no buildup.
metaphor: Chip manufacturing is 3D printing a microscopic city layer-by-layer using extreme UV light (13.5 nm), where each floor is a circuit pattern 10,000x thinner than hair.

claims.claim: Semiconductor fabrication starts with 99.99% pure silicon ingots
claims.basis: ASML source: 'Wafers are sliced from a salami-shaped bar of 99.99% pure silicon (known as an ingot)'

claims.claim: Wafers are sliced thin and polished to atomic smoothness (~0.1 nm roughness)
claims.basis: ASML: 'polished to extreme smoothness'; Microchip USA: 'Sliced into thin wafers, Polished to achieve a mirror-like finish'

claims.claim: Deposition adds thin films of conducting and insulating materials
claims.basis: ASML: 'Thin films of conducting, isolating or semiconducting materials... are deposited on the wafer'

claims.claim: Photoresist is coated then patterned by EUV lithography
claims.basis: ASML: 'The wafer is then covered with a light-sensitive coating called photoresist... lithography stage'

claims.claim: EUV lithography uses 13.5 nm wavelength light
claims.basis: Microchip USA: 'Extreme Ultraviolet (EUV) lithography uses 13.5-nanometer wavelength light'

claims.claim: Etch removes unwanted material to form circuit patterns
claims.basis: ASML: 'advances in... etch... are enablers of shrink'; Wikipedia: 'etching... during which electronic circuits are gradually created'
ASML: 'ionization'; Microchip USA: 'Doping and ion implantation'; Wikipedia: 'ion implantation'

claims.claim: The process repeats for 100+ layers in advanced chips
claims.basis: Wikipedia: 'processing steps are repeated in different sequences'; Microchip USA: 'hundreds of manufacturing steps'

claims.claim: Advanced chip fabrication takes up to 15 weeks (11–13 weeks industry average)
claims.basis: Wikipedia: 'fabrication can take up to 15 weeks, with 11–13 weeks being the industry average'

claims.claim: Modern chips contain billions of transistors
claims.basis: Wikipedia: 'modern 14/10/7 nm nodes' implying high density; general semiconductor knowledge
